description: This file is a PHP-based web page that serves as the interface for viewing and managing troubleshooting logs, including system, event, and firewall logs. It includes HTML, JavaScript, and PHP to render, filter, and fetch logs dynamically via AJAX.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts table headers and attributes for accessibility, replacing tds with thead th elements and setting headers for each row.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch logs based on selected mode and time frame; populates the corresponding table with the results.
